thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: P0 - inference-runtime - 5xx rate spike detected for service "inference-runtime". metric: requests_5xx_ratio > 0.05 over 1m window. paging: @alex
pagerbot: paging @alex (on-call) - please acknowledge
alex: ack. looking. jumping into logs and trying to repro. 5xxs seem concentrated on the `v2/generate` route
maria: I'm seeing elevated latency on a few GPU nodes in cluster-a. could be hot-shard. adding `eng-runtime` to thread.
jake: adding `eng-runtime` and `eng-platform` - I can check autoscaler and current pool sizes
kevin: rolling back last config change? recent deploy to runtime happened ~15m ago
alex: checking deploy history... there was a small config tweak to batcher.shards at 12:14 UTC
sophia: logs show `CUDA out of memory` on pod inference-gtx-3 for a subset of requests. eviction + retry spike
alex: mitigation plan: 1) cordon the bad node, 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs, 3) enable fallback model variant (quantized) for high_latency clients. starting now
dev-platform: executing scale command: `kubectl scale hpa inference-runtime --replicas=6` (started)
alex: cordoned node inference-gtx-3, draining in progress
pagerbot: deploy-bot: rollback attempt started for release `runtime-config-2025-07-05-12:10` by @alex
maria: scaled GPUs are coming up, observed reduced OOMs on new pods
jake: can confirm queue length dropping and 5xx ratio falling from 6.3% -> 1.1% over last 3m
alex: marking incident as mitigated; still under monitoring. will keep thread open for tuning discussion
kevin: postmortem note: alerts triggered at 5% threshold which was too aggressive for normal deploy flakiness. noise during small rolling restarts.
sophia: agree. we should tune the alert and add a dashboard that helps on-call quickly triage next time
alex: proposal for alert changes: - increase `requests_5xx_ratio` threshold from 0.05 -> 0.08 for 1m, and add a 5m window alert for sustained >0.04. Also add a CPU/GPU saturation gating condition
maria: also suggest gating by `pod_restart_rate` and `oom_killed` flags so we don't page for transient bursts
jake: +1. Also we need a succinct Grafana dashboard for incident retrospectives: minimal panels for golden signals + drilldowns
alex: sketching panels we should add:
- Overall golden signals row: 99/95/50 latency, 5xx rate, throughput (req/s), saturation (GPU util)
- Per-route 5xx heatmap + top failing clients
- Per-node GPU memory usage + OOM events timeline
- Batcher queue length + avg batch size
- KV cache hit rate + prefix cache size
- Recent deploys and config changes (datadog/deploy-bot links)
- Link to traces filtered by request id
kevin: for drilldowns: clicking a route should filter to per-pod timeseries + recent logs. Grafana link target should include `var-route` and `var-pod`
sophia: PromQL queries i used while triaging (feel free to copy):
```
# 5xx ratio
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[1m]))

# GPU mem used per pod
avg by (pod)(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes{job="k8s-metrics"})

# batcher queue length
sum(inference_batcher_queue_length) by (shard)
```
alex: action items
- A1 (alex): update alert rules as proposed and add 5m sustained alert (due today)
- A2 (maria): create Grafana dashboard template for incident retros (panels above) and wire template variables `route`, `pod`, `time_range` (due EOD tomorrow)
- A3 (jake): update runbook with gating conditions and add quick-playbook for cordon+scale (due today)
- A4 (kevin): create an automated check that links recent deploys to alerts so we can suppress alerts during safe restarts (follow-up ticket)

maria: starting dashboard PR: dashboard name `Infra / inference-runtime / incident-retrospective` ; will include panel JSON and exported Prom queries
jake: runbook PR incoming
alex: handoff note for next oncall (jake): incident mitigated, alerts tuned (pending PR), GPUs scaled, watch for regression for 6h
jake: ack handoff. I'll monitor next 6h. if 5xx > 2% open incident. will also review dashboard PR
